hebrewText: כֶּ֣סֶף מְרֻקָּ֞ע מִ/תַּרְשִׁ֣ישׁ יוּבָ֗א וְ/זָהָב֙ מֵֽ/אוּפָ֔ז מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָ֖שׁ וִ/ידֵ֣י צוֹרֵ֑ף תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָן֙ לְבוּשָׁ֔/ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֲכָמִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal)
tokens.kjv: beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to pound the earth ; by analogy to expand ; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to pound the earth ; by analogy to expand ; by implication
tokens.explanation: to pound the earth ; by analogy to expand ; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to pound the earth ; by analogy to expand ; by implication

tokens.bdb: Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite
to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
tokens.kjv: act, art, [phrase] bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, [idiom] well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.
artificer, ([phrase]) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, [phrase] mason, skilful, ([phrase]) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

tokens.bdb: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
tokens.kjv: ([phrase] be) able, [idiom] about, [phrase] armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, [idiom] bounty, [phrase] broad, (broken-) handed, [idiom] by, charge, coast, [phrase] consecrate, [phrase] creditor, custody, debt, dominion, [idiom] enough, [phrase] fellowship, force, [idiom] from, hand(-staves, -y work), [idiom] he, himself, [idiom] in, labour, [phrase] large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, [idiom] mine, ministry, near, [idiom] of, [idiom] order, ordinance, [idiom] our, parts, pain, power, [idiom] presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, [phrase] swear, terror, [idiom] thee, [idiom] by them, [idiom] themselves, [idiom] thine own, [idiom] thou, through, [idiom] throwing, [phrase] thumb, times, [idiom] to, [idiom] under, [idiom] us, [idiom] wait on, (way-) side, where, [phrase] wide, [idiom] with (him, me, you), work, [phrase] yield, [idiom] yourselves.
tokens.explanation: yad — mão, força, poder, influência, autoridade

tokens.bdb: to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: cast, (re-) fine(-er), founder, goldsmith, melt, pure, purge away, try.

tokens.bdb: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
purple (the color or the dyed stuff)
a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife
tokens.kjv: apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.enLiteralWord: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.explanation: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.explanationEn: a garment ; by implication  a wife

tokens.kjv: act, art, [phrase] bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, [idiom] well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo
